workflows.name: Public-information request handling
workflows.temporal_scope: Amended norms; Deta actual routing unvalidated

claims.statement: Anonymise exempt material in mixed records

rules.statement: 10-day reply / extension notice; 30-day extended reply; 5-day refusal; deadline calculation in Art.16(2)-(3).
Postal registration number communicated on request; immediate verbal answers have a separate branch.

open_questions: Who owns each Deta desk task and signs the reply?
Do email, paper and Regista share a register?
What local software and redaction review are used?

workflows.name: Information-access administrative complaints
workflows.temporal_scope: Amended norms; no Deta commission mandate read

claims.statement: Propose remedy and disciplinary referral when justified

rules.statement: Complaint within 30 days of learning of refusal; reply within 15 days of registration regardless of outcome.

open_questions: Which Deta disposition establishes the commission?
What is the local complaint register and recusal process?

workflows.name: Petition handling

claims.statement: Forward to specialist unit with reply deadline
Forward misdirected petition and notify petitioner
Refer anonymous harassment allegations to the designated officer or commission (exception to filing anonymous petitions)

rules.statement: Ordinary reply: 30 days; justified extension up to 15, or 30 for energy/gas, with prior notification.
Anonymous petitions are generally closed, but harassment exception added in 2024 must be handled.
Reply includes legal basis; subject of complaint and subordinates cannot resolve it.

open_questions: Which Deta intake is a petition rather than FOI or a service application?
Who is delegated to sign?
How are recusal and harassment exceptions routed?

workflows.name: Consulting on draft normative acts

claims.statement: Publish draft notice and supporting material
Organise debate when qualifying written request requires it
Publish debate material and final adopted text

rules.statement: Ordinary notice at least 30 working days before review; at least 10 calendar days for written recommendations.
Urgent circumstances can shorten ordinary period; qualifying debate request and disclosure deadlines remain distinct rules.

open_questions: Which local employee maintains the register?
Are website, office and media notices synchronised?
What evidence supports urgency exceptions?

workflows.name: Public meeting participation and minutes

claims.statement: Publish minutes and voting record where applicable

rules.statement: Meeting announcement at least 3 days beforehand.

open_questions: Obtain council ROF for voting, agenda approval and legal review.
Who prepares and checks minutes?

workflows.name: Local fiscal certificate

claims.statement: Issue certificate using local tax-claims records

rules.statement: Issuance within two working days; validity 30 days.
Third-party consent, succession and electronic-verification exceptions require separate variants.

open_questions: Who checks identity, consent and discrepancies locally?
Is issuance actually automated?
Which current local form and signature procedure apply?

workflows.name: Local tax overpayment refund
workflows.temporal_scope: ANAF displayed update through OUG 38/2026; local form listed
open_questions: Obtain local refund procedure and current form fields.
Who establishes entitlement and approves payment?
How is treasury execution reconciled?

workflows.name: Local nonprofit grant selection and award

claims.statement: Forward registered documents to commission secretariat

rules.statement: At least 65/100 points; scoring gap above 10 triggers re-evaluation.
Result communication within 10 days; contracting within 20 days of communication.

open_questions: Resolve Art.17 result/endorsement ordering against Arts.34-35.
Obtain 2026 applicable call and rules after national amendment.
Who records checks and manages conflicts of interest?

workflows.name: Grant reporting, instalments and control
workflows.temporal_scope: 2025 programme edition; payment desk detail incomplete

claims.statement: Submit intermediate report and supporting evidence
Withhold final settlement for missing timely report

explicit_links.condition: prior tranche justified; first tranche excepted

rules.statement: Advance capped at 50%; final reporting within 15 days of completion and by 15 December; retain file five years.

open_questions: Who validates evidence and approves each payment?
What treasury/accounting steps intervene?
What are the recovery and complaint procedures?

workflows.name: Completed municipal recruitment sequence
workflows.temporal_scope: One June 2021 municipal competition; not current recruitment rules
open_questions: Read current 2026 vacancy notice and applicable recruitment law.
Which stages differ for civil servants and contractual employees?
What appeals and no-candidate branches apply?

unresolved_conflicts.subject: Information-access deadlines

unresolved_conflicts.resolution: Use amended norms as legal baseline; preserve old source as historical.

unresolved_conflicts.subject: Grant version
unresolved_conflicts.finding: Local HCL edition is 2025; national law portal signals Law 91/2026 applies to procedures started after its entry into force.
unresolved_conflicts.resolution: 2025 map retained; no assumption of applicability to a new 2026 call.

unresolved_conflicts.subject: Grant ordering
unresolved_conflicts.finding: Art.17 lists communication before principal credit officer review; Arts.34-35 describe minutes to mayor and later notice.
unresolved_conflicts.resolution: Do not force endorsement/communication sequence; ask owner.
